top5.title: Split the 1240-LOC auth/service god module
top5.reasoning: Highest blast radius: login, tokens, and email share one module, so every auth change risks the others. Splitting is mechanical and well bounded.

evidence.note: single module owns login, tokens, and email

top5.why_now: highest-churn module; every auth change pays the tax
top5.scope_boundary: split only; no behaviour change, no new features
top5.acceptance_criteria: module split into three units, all existing tests pass unchanged

top5.title: Cover the untested payment refund path
top5.reasoning: Refunds move money and have zero coverage; a regression is high-impact and the fix is purely additive tests.
top5.suggested_fix: add unit + integration tests for refund flows
top5.why_now: next sprint adds new refund types; untested baseline blocks safe extension
top5.scope_boundary: tests only; no refund logic changes
top5.acceptance_criteria: partial and full refund paths covered by unit and integration tests, CI green

top5.title: Extract the retry loop duplicated across six clients
top5.reasoning: Six verbatim copies of backoff logic drift independently; one shared helper removes a recurring source of bugs.
top5.why_now: two clients already diverged; consolidating now prevents a third divergence in the upcoming API migration
top5.scope_boundary: retry/backoff logic only; timeout values and error handling unchanged
top5.acceptance_criteria: single withRetry helper used by all six clients, existing retry behaviour preserved, tests pass

top5.title: Delete the never-called legacy_export path
top5.reasoning: legacy_export is superseded and unreferenced; removing it shrinks the surface with no behavioural risk.
top5.why_now: dead code is indexed by tooling and misleads new contributors during onboarding
top5.scope_boundary: legacy_export module and its dedicated tests only; export.v2 untouched
top5.acceptance_criteria: legacy_export deleted, no references remain, full test suite passes

top5.title: Fix README install steps pointing at a removed script
top5.reasoning: New contributors follow install steps that reference a deleted setup.sh; a quick doc fix unblocks onboarding.

evidence.note: points at setup.sh deleted last release

top5.suggested_fix: update install section to current bootstrap
top5.why_now: new hire onboarding scheduled next week; stale steps will waste setup time
top5.scope_boundary: README install section only; no code changes
top5.acceptance_criteria: README install steps reference current bootstrap script and a fresh clone succeeds end-to-end
